text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I somehow... managed to finish the 
race—but)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (...What is this feeling...?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (I still... can't stop the goosebumps...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur... murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Daaammit, that was so close, Duramente!! I 
was sure you had it!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"That final burst of speed at the end was 
incredible... It gave me chills just 
watching it..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (I see... It's Duramente-san...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(The true nature of that terrifying 
presence that clung to me the whole time I 
was running—)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: “...... What's this?”

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, I'm so, so sorry. I just... um... 
sort of—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I-It was just so amazing... the way you 
ran...! It was... so powerful...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I thought I was going to be swallowed 
whole... By some massive, unknown 
beast...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(That's how... ferocious her presence 
was...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...However, if I don't win, none of it 
means anything.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
For someone like me who seeks to be 'the 
strongest,' you are saying that anything 
less than victory is 'worthless.'

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I run to prove that my bloodline brings 
about the 'strongest'—that is why I race.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
In other words, victory is a 
"prerequisite." Failing to fulfill that 
"prerequisite," I have no right to speak 
of today's race.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: That's right... Victory is my sole duty—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Next time, I will prove who is the 
"strongest."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: They're... gone...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(How intense... Chasing "the strongest"—so 
straightforwardly...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(That's Duramente-san's resolve. A fierce 
determination to make her dream come true, 
no matter what...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Am I really going to compete against 
someone like her...? To make my dream come 
true, I have to surpass her...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Besides......—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Next is the Derby...! At the Derby... 
I will... gh!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...The Satsuki Sho is over. But the Triple 
Crown races have only just begun.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to waste. We need to 
switch gears for the Derby right away—!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Kita-san. Crown-san, too...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Why can you look forward so quickly? I'm 
still... terrified from earlier...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I greet Cheval Grand in the underground 
tunnel after she finishes competing on the 
grand stage of the Satsuki Sho."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer... san...
choice_data_list: Good work, you gave it your all!
Good work, you gave it your all!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "—N-No, it's nothing! It's just..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I guess... I was just overwhelmed... 
Everyone was so incredible...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is so different from someone like 
me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed that the word "everyone" did not 
include Cheval Grand herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hoping that someday I can say, "I was 
amazing too," I headed back to the waiting 
room alongside Cheval Grand.
